cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: You Handle the Evidence
cards.instruction: Make someone else take responsibility for the evidence, loose end, or difficult follow-up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Will you explain my missing magician's receipt to the treasurer? You booked him.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You paid him. I only found his number.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then ring him for a replacement. You've got the number.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He won't send a duplicate unless the treasurer emails him directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then draft her email and get her to send it. Copy yourself in so you can chase him.
